name: Filesystem
summary: Read and write files under directories you choose. Scoped to the paths you pass, nothing else.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Edit the last argument to the directory you want exposed. Node is required.

name: Fetch
summary: Fetch a URL and convert it to markdown, with redirect and robots handling.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Needs uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Versions are pinned because newer MCP SDK releases break this server.

name: Git
summary: Read a repository's history, diffs, and branches, and stage or commit changes.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Point --repository at the checkout you want. Needs uv. Versions are pinned because newer MCP SDK releases break this server.

name: GitHub
summary: Issues, pull requests, code search, and repository management on GitHub.
author: GitHub
setup: Create a personal access token with repo scope at https://github.com/settings/tokens.

name: PostgreSQL
summary: Inspect schemas and run read-only queries against a Postgres database.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Replace the connection string with your own.

name: SQLite
summary: Query and modify a SQLite database file, with schema introspection.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Point --db-path at your database. Needs uv. Versions are pinned because newer MCP SDK releases break this server.

name: Knowledge graph memory
summary: A persistent knowledge graph of entities and relations the agent can add to and query.
author: Model Context Protocol

name: Sequential thinking
summary: A scratchpad for step-by-step reasoning that can branch and revise earlier steps.
author: Model Context Protocol

name: Time and timezones
summary: Current time anywhere, and conversion between timezones.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Needs uv. Versions are pinned because newer MCP SDK releases break older server packages.

name: Slack
summary: Read channels and threads, and post messages to a Slack workspace.
author: Model Context Protocol
setup: Create a Slack app, add bot scopes, and install it to the workspace.

name: Brave Search
summary: Web and local search through the Brave Search API.
author: Model Context Protocol

name: Notion
summary: Search, read, and update Notion pages and databases.
author: Notion
setup: Create an internal integration at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and share the pages with it.

name: Linear
summary: Issues, projects, and cycles in Linear.
author: Linear
setup: Hosted Streamable HTTP server. OAuth is required; bearer-token headers can be configured manually.

name: Sentry
summary: Look up issues and stack traces from Sentry.
author: Sentry
setup: Hosted Streamable HTTP server. OAuth is required; bearer-token headers can be configured manually.

name: Playwright
summary: Accessibility-tree browser automation from the Playwright team.
author: Microsoft

name: Everything (reference server)
summary: Exercises every part of the protocol — tools, prompts, resources, and sampling. Useful for checking that MCP works at all.
author: Model Context Protocol
